title: "svelte/no-shorthand-style-property-overrides"
description: "Disallow shorthand style properties that override related longhand properties"
# Generated by src/codegen/lint-rule-docs.ts. Do not edit below this line.

A shorthand property such as `margin` resets all of its longhands. Set after `margin-top` on the same element, it silently throws the `margin-top` away. Longhands with a vendor prefix count for the shorthand with the same prefix, `-webkit-margin-top` for `-webkit-margin`.

The element's `style` attribute and `style:` directives are read in order, the attribute the way eslint-plugin-svelte reads it: a `{mustache}` between declarations counts as every string or template literal it can be, through `? :`, `&&`, `||` and `??`, and those declarations don't count against each other. A value with an at-rule, a block, or a `{mustache}` inside a comment isn't checked.

{/* Generated by src/codegen/lint-rule-docs.ts. Do not edit this section. */}

## Configure

Off by default. It runs on the Svelte components that an ESLint config lints with `svelte-eslint-parser`, in the place of the rule of `eslint-plugin-svelte`:

{/* skip */}

```js eslint.config.js
import svelte from "eslint-plugin-svelte";

export default [
  ...svelte.configs.recommended,
  { rules: { "svelte/no-shorthand-style-property-overrides": "error" } },
];
```

{/* End of the generated section. */}

## Examples

Reported:

{/* bad */}

```svelte
<div style="margin-top: 8px; margin: 0">Saved</div>
<div style:padding-left="4px" style:padding="0">Saved</div>
```

Not reported:

{/* good */}

```svelte
<div style="margin: 0; margin-top: 8px">Saved</div>
<div style="{compact ? 'padding-left: 4px; padding: 0' : ''}">Saved</div>
```
